protocol.prompt: Same frozen 8192 token IDs as the reference; SHA256 recorded per run.
protocol.generation: 512 token IDs, fixed length with stop IDs disabled. Decode times 511 advances after the prefill token.
protocol.warmup: Two complete requests, then a discarded prefill request; three timed requests in one process.
protocol.residency: All timed major faults and observed swap must be zero. Decoder must exit successfully.
protocol.cgroup_scope: before/after numeric memory-controller records; peaks include the whole allocation, not only the selected run.
protocol.quality_selection: Select using throughput and three training tasks, then evaluate the frozen twenty held-out tasks once. No held-out tuning.

route_drop.scope: cumulative across all warmup and measured requests; every reported bound checked
cumulative across all warmup and measured requests; every reported bound checked

coding.scope: Text-only C++ tasks with independent compiled execution oracles, temperature zero, real EOS stops, 1536-token answer cap. This is a small functional check, not a general quality or perplexity qualification.

final_target_host_tests.scope: Final CPU tests rebuilt on the target Xeon: native VNNI, forced AVX2, scalar, pool, route policy and C11 contracts.

all_new_flags_off.scope: Native FP4, all new CPU options off, same frozen 8192-token prompt. Output check only; no speed qualification.

validation.excluded_attempts: Earlier q8-v2/v3/v4/v5 attempts had stale source/object timestamps or failed builds. No rates from those attempts are included. Original private raw evidence was retained.

host_tests.scope: Ryzen 9 3950X; native AVX2 and scalar execution. Real VNNI execution is recorded separately for the target Xeon.

policy_freeze.decision: Select on repeated throughput and training only. Greedy and CUDA-graph controls were below 20 tok/s; the MTP candidate must meet 20 tok/s with clean residency and at least the baseline 2/3 training count.

limitations: GPU arithmetic is W4A16; optional CPU arithmetic is W4A8. ModelOpt FP4 activation emulation is not implemented.
Routing mass is bounded per token and main layer; that bound is not a bound on logits or output error. Renormalization changes retained CPU and GPU routing coefficients.
Cold loading, registration, first-use caches and process shutdown are excluded from timed decode. Short-run and instrumented controls are not repeated 512-token qualification.
The same-day reference rerun had timed major faults in two samples; its median is diagnostic. The original clean three-repeat 5.2608604 tok/s record is preserved.
The pre-existing short-prefill sequence/batch relative-L2 gate failed for both original kernels; FP16 long-prompt attention is also lossy. These original limitations remain.
Teacher-forced perplexity/KL for the selected route-dropping policy was not measured. Vision, multiple concurrent requests and full GGUF/EXL3 model regressions were not tested.
No new full-model ComputeSanitizer run was performed for this selected policy.
CUDA 12.9 SM70 was executed on V100. Additional CUDA 13.2 SM86 and HIP gfx1201 checks were compile-only. SYCL uses a separate backend and does not compile the changed engine files.
GPU clocks were not locked; RAM speed was not recorded. Rates apply to this prompt, hardware, configuration and resident timing protocol.
evidence_corrections: Earlier V2-V5 builds used stale source timestamps or failed to link; their rates were excluded. Later archives were extracted without restoring timestamps and source files were hashed.

The V11 build script initially compared correct V11 source against the V10 manifest. A corrected audit matched all 482 source files without changing source or executable; original failed audit logs were retained privately.
An early route-statistics guard assumed one summary, but the engine emits cumulative per-request reports. The corrected guard checks all reports; original failed guard output was retained.

The first attempted library-prefetch run did not start its helper correctly; its phase guard rejected a late preparation attempt. It is excluded from qualified results. A later run uses an explicit readiness handshake and records preparation before any timed request.

The first full MTP qualification had 30 timed major faults in its third sample; an unchanged rerun had 32 in its third sample; all three outputs matched but the run failed residency qualification. Its raw record is retained and listed as an unqualified control.
Runs interrupted by allocation expiry and an intentionally interrupted reference control remain private raw evidence and are excluded from qualified rates.
